coop.notes: P1 operates the terminal plate and pulse; P2 carries and places the ACh packet. Solo uses the P1 union: step on the plate, carry and place the packet, then pulse the terminal.

authoring.notes: M2 Endplate Ferry: interact at the motor terminal; the terminal plate starts the Ca²⁺ window; the ACh packet crosses the cleft to the nicotinic receptor; the terminal pulse binds it; the Ca²⁺ gate + receptor relay opens the latched muscle gate. Uses prompt-obj-2 because per-level debrief prompts are not authored. Automated unit, pack validation, smoke, and browser checks passed; human solo/co-op playtesting is pending.
